decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used only for restaurant purposes with or without take-away facilities and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 2010 or an order revoking or re-enacting that order.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the hours of 05:00 to 24:00hrs Monday to Sunday.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken to or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 8.30am to 7.00pm Monday to Saturday, nor at any time on Sundays or Bank Holidays.
Condition : 5 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the drawing 940443/12a shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 6 - The details of the landscaping previously approved shall be permanently maintained for the lifetime of the development.
description: Variation of Condition 1 (hours of opening) of permission 00607/B/P13 granted on 08/02/2005 for a variation of Condition 5 (Opening and closing hours) of planning ref 00607/B/P11.
